$comment: Mirrors the Cookbook's Pydantic Entity/Relation classes as plain JSON Schema, so validate_extraction.py can check any tool's output without needing pydantic installed.

name.description: Surface form exactly as it appears in the document.

description.description: Context from the document — this is what makes resolution possible later.

subject.description: Must match an entity name in this same document's entities list.

object.description: Must match an entity name in this same document's entities list.
